ValidationRule.description: This validation is created as part of STY-00853 which describes Rating is required to close the case.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND($Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.CaseValidations__c != true, ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed'), RecordType.DeveloperName != 'NSP_ITA_CQA', RecordType.DeveloperName != 'NSP_WX_IMPL', RecordType.DeveloperName != 'Dunning', ISBLANK(TEXT(NSP_Rating__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Update Quick Rate in order to close the Case.
